description_en: Queries the specified computing resource based on the computing resource ID
description_zh: 根据计算资源ID，查询指定的计算资源
name: GetComputeResource

parameters.help_en: The computing resource ID, which is the unique identifier for the resource
parameters.help_zh: 计算资源 ID，计算资源的唯一标识符
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace
parameters.name: project_id

ComputeResource.description_en: The details of the computing resource

ConnectionProperties.description_en:
The specific connection configuration details for the computing resource, including the connection address, access identity, and environment information. envType, which specifies the computing resource environment, is a property of this object. Valid values:

Dev

Prod Different types of computing resources have different attribute specifications under various configuration modes (ConnectionPropertiesMode)
ConnectionProperties.description_zh:
计算资源的具体连接配置信息，包括连接地址、访问身份、环境信息等。计算资源环境 envType 信息是此对象的成员属性，包括

Dev（开发环境）；
Prod（生产环境）；
不同类型的计算资源在不同的配置模式（ConnectionPropertiesMode）下具有不同的属性信息规范，

ConnectionPropertiesMode.description_en:
The addition category of the computing resource. Different types will have different subtypes, each with corresponding parameter constraints. For instance:

InstanceMode: Instance mode

UrlMode: Connection String Mode

CdhMode: CDH mode
ConnectionPropertiesMode.description_zh:
计算资源添加的类别，不同 type 下会有不同的子类型，对应有不同的参数约束，场景举例：
InstanceMode 实例模式；
UrlMode 连接串模式；
CdhMode：CDH 模式

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time, in timestamp format

Description.description_en: The description of the computing resource

Id.description_en: The ID of the computing resource

ModifyTime.description_en: The last modification time, in timestamp format
ModifyTime.description_zh: 最近修改的时间（时间戳）

Name.description_en: The name of the computing resource

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the computing resource belongs
ProjectId.description_zh: 计算资源所属项目空间 ID

QualifiedName.description_en: The business unique key for the computing resource. For example, the format for Hologres is ${tenantOwnerId}:${regionId}:${type}:${instanceId}:${database}
QualifiedName.description_zh: 计算资源的业务唯一键，以 Holo 举例格式是${tenantOwnerId}:${regionId}:${type}:${instanceId}:${database}

Type.description_en: The type of the computing resource

WhetherDefault.description_en: Specifies whether it is the default computing resource

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the request ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位日志，排查问题
